before: Tab over any selection outside a list replaced the selection with a tab character, which deleted the selected text.
after: Tab over a selection of two or more paragraphs, or over a selection from a paragraph start, writes w:ind with the existing setParagraphProperties operation and keeps the text. A caret, or a selection in one paragraph that starts inside the text, still types a tab.
reason: The change uses only the existing paragraph property operation that Increase Indent already sends. It adds no shared state, operations, snapshot fields, or protocol messages.
